links.outcome: Hallucination rate in LLM-generated root cause analyses of radiation oncology incidents
links.effect: All four models exhibited some degree of hallucination, ranging from 11% to 61%; models differed significantly in hallucination rate (p < 0.05).
links.quote: All models exhibited some degree of hallucination, ranging from 11% to 61%.

unlisted_practices: LLM-assisted root cause analysis of patient safety incident reports using AAPM RCA guideline-based prompts

screen.reason: Evaluates the capability of several commercial LLMs to perform root cause analysis on radiation oncology incident reports with expert clinician adjudication, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice comparison.
